title: Easton Pond Dam Resilience
summary: Raise South Easton Pond embankment and armor against wave attack and saltwater intrusion. Protects the island drinking water supply.

title: Mill Creek Nature Based Flood Mitigation
summary: Restore Mill Creek with box culverts and nature based solutions to cut flooding and storm surge risk.

title: Elizabeth Brook Floodplain Restoration
summary: Restore about 1,200 linear feet of Elizabeth Brook to reduce flooding and improve coastal resilience.

title: Maidford River Floodplain Restoration
summary: Restore floodplain function and improve drainage along the Maidford River to reduce flooding on Berkeley Avenue.

title: Long Wharf Pump Station Flood Barrier
summary: Install a deployable flood barrier wall to protect the Long Wharf sewer pump station from storm surge.

title: Almy Pond Shoreline Habitat Restoration
summary: Remove asphalt and restore natural shoreline habitat along Almy Pond as a coastal buffer.

title: Common Fence Point Rain Gardens
summary: Installed rain gardens, cleaned wetlands, and rehabilitated catch basins to reduce flooding.

title: Melville Dam Rehabilitation
summary: Rehabilitated the earthen Melville Dam for stronger storm resilience.

title: Islandwide Climate Resilience Plan
summary: Develop strategies, priority projects, and collaboration opportunities across Newport, Middletown, Portsmouth, and Naval Station Newport.

title: Working Group Capacity and Engagement
summary: Support Land, Water, and People Working Groups with over 70 members from more than 40 organizations.

title: Hazard Mitigation Plan Coordination
summary: Regional multi jurisdictional Hazard Mitigation Plan approved by all three municipal councils.

title: Cooling and Extreme Heat Preparedness
summary: SAMPLE action for demonstration. Identify cooling centers and heat vulnerability outreach.

title: Coastal Marsh Migration Corridors
summary: SAMPLE action for demonstration. Map and protect corridors for marsh migration under sea level rise.

title: Stormwater Green Infrastructure Pilot
summary: SAMPLE action for demonstration. Pilot green infrastructure in flood prone neighborhoods.

title: Resilience Financing Strategy Updates
summary: SAMPLE action for demonstration. Refresh municipal financing strategies for priority projects.
